{{nihongo|'''Kasuga Shrine'''|春日神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

'''Kasuga Shrine''' (かすがじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Osaka|af|Osaka-prefektuur|an|Prefectura d'Osaka|ang|Ōsacascir|ar|أوساكا (محافظة)|arz|محافظة اوساكا|ast|Prefeutura d'Osaka|az|Osaka prefekturası|azb|اوساکا اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Osaka|bat_smg|Osakas prefektūra|be|Осака (прэфектура)|bg|Осака (префектура)|bjn|Prefektur Osaka|bn|ওসাকা প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura d'Osaka|cdo|Ōsaka-hū|ce|Осака (префектура)|ceb|Ōsaka-fu|ckb|پارێزگای ئۆساکا|cs|Prefektura Ósaka|cy|Osaka (talaith)|da|Osaka-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Osaka|eo|Gubernio Osako|es|Prefectura de Osaka|et|Ōsaka prefektuur|eu|Osaka (prefektura)|fa|استان اوساکا|fi|Osakan prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture d'Osaka|frr|Ōsaka (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Ōsaka|gl|Prefectura de Osaca|hak|Thai-fán-fú|he|אוסקה (מחוז)|hr|Ōsaka (prefektura)|hu|Oszaka prefektúra|hy|Օսակա (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Osaka|ilo|Prepektura ti Osaka|it|Prefettura di Osaka|ja|大阪府|jv|Prefektur Osaka|ka|ოსაკის პრეფექტურა|kaa|Osaka prefekturası|km|ខេត្តអូសាកា|ko|오사카부|la|Osakensis|lt|Osakos prefektūra|lv|Osakas prefektūra|mk|Осака (префектура)|mni|ꯑꯣꯁꯥꯀꯥ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|ओसाका प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Osaka|mwl|Ousaca|my|အိုဆာကာခရိုင်|nl|Osaka (prefectuur)|no|Osaka (prefektur)|nov|Osaka Prefekture|os|Осакæ (префектурæ)|pl|Prefektura Osaka|pnb|ضلع اوساکا|pt|Osaka (prefeitura)|ro|Prefectura Osaka|ru|Осака (префектура)|sco|Osaka Prefectur|sd|اوساڪا پريفيڪچر|se|Ōsaka prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Osaka|si|ඕසකා ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Osaka Prefecture|sk|Osaka (prefektúra)|sl|Prefektura Osaka|sr|Префектура Осака|su|Préféktur Osaka|sv|Osaka prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Osaka|tg|Префектураи Осака|th|จังหวัดโอซากะ|tl|Prepektura ng Osaka|tr|Osaka (prefektörlük)|tt|Осака (префектура)|uk|Префектура Осака|ur|اوساکا پریفیکچر|vec|Prefetura de Osaka|vi|Ōsaka|war|Osaka (prefektura)|wuu|大阪府|zh|大阪府|zh_classical|大阪府|zh_min_nan|Tāi-pán-hú|zh_yue|大阪府|qid=Q122723}}, {{ill|Ibaraki, Osaka|Q502403|qid=Q502403}}. It is an {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}-listed {{ill|Settsu Province|Q864163|qid=Q864163}} {{ill|Shimashimo district|Q10976940|qid=Q10976940}} {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and is regarded as a {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|Q135022904|qid=Q135022904}} (shrine identified through scholarly debate).

=== History ===
One of the two seats of the Shikinaisha {{ill|Sukuku Shrine|Q11664487|qid=Q11664487}}, according to the “Jingū Zōreishū,” on April 5 of {{ill|Tenpyō|Q1199879|qid=Q1199879}} 12 ({{ill|740|Q23593|qid=Q23593}}), {{ill|Minister of the Right|Q1351174|qid=Q1351174}} {{ill|Ōnakatomi no Kiyomaro|Q11431854|qid=Q11431854|lt=Nakatomi no Kiyomaro}} secluded himself at this site and enshrined his ancestral deities near his residence.
* In {{ill|Meireki|Q1192766|qid=Q1192766}} 1 ({{ill|1655|Q6975|qid=Q6975}}), it became independent from the affiliated villages of Moto-Sukuku-shō Village and came to be called {{ill|Kasuga Shrines|Q10855011|qid=Q10855011}}.
* In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 5 ({{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}}), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.
* On August 28, {{ill|Heisei era|Q234510|qid=Q234510}} 22 ({{ill|2010|Q1995|qid=Q1995}}), a fire caused by suspected arson destroyed the main hall and worship hall.
* On March 25, Heisei 24 ({{ill|2012|Q1990|qid=Q1990}}), reconstruction of the main hall and worship hall was completed.
